description: Browse the public trustlists directory by exact trust center platform, listed framework, or CSA STAR level. Use for questions like "show SafeBase-hosted vendors", "find entries listing ISO 27001", or "list CSA STAR Level 2 companies". Results are directory metadata, not security ratings.

framework.description: Case-insensitive listed framework text, such as "SOC 2", "ISO 27001", or "PCI DSS".

offset.description: Number of matching records to skip for pagination.

platform.description: Exact platform name, such as "Vanta", "SafeBase", or "Self-hosted".

name: trustlists_browse
